tasks.q: Why are embedded systems usually cheap to make?

info.title: Computers on wheels
info.text: A modern car has dozens of embedded computers, often more than 50, controlling everything from the engine to the windows.

info.title: Life-saving computers
info.text: Pacemakers are embedded systems that must be extremely reliable and run for years on one battery.

info.title: The Internet of Things
info.text: When embedded systems connect to the internet, like smart speakers and doorbells, they're called the Internet of Things.

info.title: Microcontrollers
info.text: A microcontroller combines a CPU, memory and input/output on one tiny chip: a whole computer the size of a fingernail.

info.title: Space-proof code
info.text: The Mars rovers are controlled by embedded systems whose software can be updated from Earth, millions of kilometres away.

info.title: Real time
info.text: Anti-lock brakes must respond in milliseconds. Systems that must react instantly are called real-time systems.
